item.title: Whiskers 0.8.47
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.47

### AI Enhancement Models

  • Added recommended model cards so you can quickly choose fast, low-cost, or higher-quality enhancement options
  • Added an All Models view with provider groups and search, making it easier to find and switch between supported cloud models
  • Added custom provider setup for self-hosted or compatible AI services, with saved API key selection and flexible authentication options

    • ### API Keys & Cloud Transcription

  • Improved API key management so each provider clearly shows which saved key is active
  • Improved Cloud Transcription model selection with recommended models, setup prompts, and per-model key selection
  • Made setup-required cloud models visible before you add a key, so you can compare options before connecting a provider

    • ### Recording HUD

  • Fixed locked recording setup so cancel and finish controls appear as soon as hands-free recording is preparing
